name: quaketrack.normalized_earthquake
stage: processed Silver records, not raw GeoJSON features
null_policy: Optional fields may be missing or null; never replace unknown measurements with zero.

uniqueness.duplicate_policy: all rows in a duplicate-ID group fail dataset uniqueness

source_update_policy: Only a known newer source_updated_at can replace an existing representation. Equal, older or missing revisions cannot overwrite it; occurrence and ingestion times are distinct.

provenance.bronze: Immutable response bytes plus source, request parameters, run ID, UTC fetched_at and SHA-256 metadata.
provenance.staged_silver: Source archive references and checksums in the checkpoint manifest; quarantine excluded.
provenance.persisted_silver: Required UUID last_run_id references ingestion_runs; chunks and raw_archives retain source provenance. Validated when require_provenance is enabled.

report_denominator: Every supplied processed row, before any deduplication. Rows with field/provenance errors or repeated event IDs fail compliance. Empty input has null compliance percentage. This is not the raw-source acceptance rate.
